roles.title: Price & positioning neuron
roles.sense: You sense price action and derivatives positioning together: trend, support/resistance, moving averages, momentum, volume profile and relative strength on the candles, plus funding rates, open interest, liquidations and options data. Use both parts of your data. Ignore news and on-chain flows.

roles.title: Money & news neuron
roles.sense: You sense where money is moving and why: exchange volume, the Coinbase and Upbit premiums, stablecoin supply, what the most profitable traders hold and changed, plus news headlines, the macro calendar, earnings and prediction-market odds. Use all parts of your data. Ignore chart patterns and derivatives.
